nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the Whapes sale is paused; toggled by startSale and pauseSale and read as a gate in mintAWhape.
Boolean flag ensuring the provenance hash can only be written once by setProvenanceHash.
Public provenance record string written by setProvenanceHash.
Price in wei of a single Whape, read by getWhapePrice and written by setWhapePrice.
Constant timestamp before which minting is not allowed; used as a time gate in mintAWhape.
Constant timestamp after which the starting index block is locked in mintAWhape.
Constant maximum number of Whapes (9999) used for supply caps and modulo of blockhash randomness.
Block number recorded when the sale ends; read in finalizeStartingIndex as the seed for randomness.
Final starting index derived from blockhash in finalizeStartingIndex.
Payable public mint entry point; validates time, pause state, supply and payment, then loops _safeMint and sets startingIndexBlock.
onlyOwner function that derives startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock (weak randomness source).
onlyOwner function that transfers the full contract balance to msg.sender.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites salesPrice.
onlyOwner function that loops _safeMint to reserve up to 9 tokens for giveaways.
View helper returning salesPrice after a supply check; called by mintAWhape.
View helper returning the per-transaction mint cap (20) after a supply check; called by mintAWhape.
onlyOwner one-time setter of ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE guarded by isProvenanceSet.
onlyOwner function changing the ERC721 base token URI.
onlyOwner function that unpauses the sale by setting isSalePaused to false.
onlyOwner function that pauses the sale by setting isSalePaused to true.
Constructor of Whapes that initialises the ERC721 name/symbol and sets the base URI.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, withdrawal recipient and authorization subject.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for sale start gating and reveal locking in mintAWhape.
External call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received performed by _safeMint, enabling a callback into the recipient contract.
Use of blockhash(startingIndexBlock) and blockhash(block.number-1) as pseudo-random seed in finalizeStartingIndex.
Low-level value transfer of the entire contract balance in withdraw (via msg.sender.transfer).
User-supplied mint quantity parameter of mintAWhape, used in the safe-math supply and payment checks.
Owner-supplied quantity parameter of reserveGiveaway that drives the giveaway mint loop.
Owner-supplied new price parameter of setWhapePrice written into salesPrice.
Owner-supplied base URI string parameter of changeBaseURI.
Owner-supplied provenance hash parameter of setProvenanceHash written into ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE.
Local variable holding totalSupply() during each mintAWhape loop iteration, used as tokenId.
Local variable holding address(this).balance before the withdrawal transfer in withdraw.
Local variable caching totalSupply() at the start of reserveGiveaway.
Loop index variable in the mintAWhape mint loop.

edges.reason: The untrusted numberOfWhapes parameter flows into SafeMath.add/SafeMath.mul supply and payment checks in mintAWhape.
block.timestamp gates whether mintAWhape can proceed (SALE_START_TIMESTAMP / REVEAL_TIMESTAMP), a timestamp dependency.
mintAWhape calls _safeMint, which performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient, enabling reentrancy before state finalization.
reserveGiveaway calls _safeMint in a loop, invoking the recipient onERC721Received external callback.
The numberOfWhapes parameter of reserveGiveaway is used as the loop bound for giveaway mints.
msg.sender is the recipient passed into _safeMint inside mintAWhape, letting the caller choose the mint target.
mintAWhape writes startingIndexBlock once the supply cap or reveal timestamp is reached.
mintAWhape reads block.timestamp to compare against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP for locking the starting block.
mintAWhape compares totalSupply plus mint amount against MAX_WHAPE_SUPPLY and reads the constant for the supply cap.
mintAWhape reads salesPrice indirectly through getWhapePrice for the payment requirement.
mintAWhape compares block.timestamp against the SALE_START_TIMESTAMP constant to gate sale start.
mintAWhape uses REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide when to lock the starting index block.
getWhapePrice returns the salesPrice state variable.
getWhapeMaxAmount validates totalSupply against MAX_WHAPE_SUPPLY before returning the cap.
mintAWhape calls getWhapePrice to compute the required payment.
mintAWhape calls getWhapeMaxAmount to enforce the per-transaction mint cap.
finalizeStartingIndex derives startingIndex from blockhash, a miner-influenceable weak randomness source.
finalizeStartingIndex writes the computed value into startingIndex.
finalizeStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock as the seed for the blockhash randomness.
setWhapePrice overwrites the salesPrice state variable.
The newPrice parameter is written into salesPrice by setWhapePrice.
withdraw performs the value transfer of the full contract balance.
withdraw is onlyOwner-protected and sends funds based on msg.sender identity.
The balance local variable is the amount used in the withdrawal value transfer.
The withdrawal transfers the entire balance to msg.sender, making the caller the beneficiary.
setProvenanceHash writes the supplied hash into ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE.
The _hash parameter flows into ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE inside setProvenanceHash.
setProvenanceHash sets isProvenanceSet to true to prevent further writes.
startSale sets isSalePaused to false, re-enabling minting.
pauseSale sets isSalePaused to true, blocking minting.
The isSalePaused flag gates whether mintAWhape can execute.
The baseURI parameter is passed into _setBaseURI by changeBaseURI.
The mintIndex local variable (totalSupply) is used as the tokenId passed to _safeMint in mintAWhape.
The currentSupply local variable seeds the tokenId sequence in the reserveGiveaway loop.
The loop index i controls iteration of the mint loop inside mintAWhape.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter of mintAWhape and only used for its supply/payment arithmetic checks, so it can be folded into that function node.
Parameter of reserveGiveaway used only as that function's mint loop bound.
Parameter of setWhapePrice directly assigned to salesPrice within that function.
Parameter of changeBaseURI forwarded to _setBaseURI inside that function.
Parameter of setProvenanceHash written directly into ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE.
Local tokenId variable computed and consumed only inside the mintAWhape loop.
Local balance variable is the amount of the withdraw value-transfer operation, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Local supply snapshot used only to compute tokenIds inside reserveGiveaway.
Loop counter used only to drive iteration of the mintAWhape mint loop.
